theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_fpm_rd_residue_surjective
theorems.statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (x : F), Transcendental K x → ∀ q : Polynomial K, Irreducible q → ∀ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F, (∀ h : v.toValuationSubring, ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ b ∧ (h : F) = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b) → ∀ e : Polynomial K →ₐ[K] v.toValuationSubring, (∀ a : Polynomial K, (e a : F) = Polynomial.aeval x a) → IsLocalRing.residue v.toValuationSubring (e q) = 0 → Function.Surjective ((IsLocalRing.residue v.toValuationSubring).comp e.toRingHom)
theorems.natural_summary: Lift a residue, express its lift as a permitted fraction, and use a Bézout inverse modulo q to exhibit a polynomial preimage.
